<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z 262.099 (ESI positive mode), the simplest interpretation is that this peak corresponds to the molecular ion (M⁺). A formula that matches this exact mass within typical experimental tolerance is C₁₄H₁₄O₅ (monoisotopic mass 262.084 Da, within ~0.02 Da of the observed value). Therefore, the molecular formula of the sample is C14H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H14O5</final_answer>
